claims.claim: 2 units of bicycle with differ prices
claims.evidence: Witness report shows two adult bicycles in Photo 0.
Witness notes some dirt/road wear; no close-up cleanliness assessment provided.
No price list or comparable market pricing evidence provided in the report.
Witness report does not confirm city/location details beyond the scene.

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or not properly adjusted (safety-critical).
risks.proof: Short video clip of both bikes: brake lever squeeze + wheel spin test (front and rear) showing immediate stop and no rubbing/drag.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'brakes not confirmed' (worst-case: needs service/adjustment).

risks.risk: Gears may be missing, non-functional, or require repair (shifting not readable).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing gear shifters/derailleurs clearly + video of shifting through all gears without skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'gear system unverified' (worst-case: single-speed or gears not working).

risks.risk: Tires may be worn, cracked, or punctured (road wear visible but tread/sidewall not confirmed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls for both bikes + check for punctures/slow leaks (inflate and hold test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'tires condition unknown' (worst-case: tires/tubes may need replacement).

risks.risk: Wheels may be out of true or have rim damage (no close-up inspection).
risks.proof: Video clip spinning each wheel with a stationary brake pad/fork as reference showing wobble (or mechanic truing check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'wheel trueness unverified' (worst-case: needs truing/rim service).

risks.risk: Missing or loose accessories/parts (lights, reflectors, pedals, basket attachment) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Full photo of each bike from both sides and close-ups of: headlight, reflectors, pedals, basket mounts, and front/rear lights wiring/fitment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'parts completeness unverified' (worst-case: some accessories missing or not secure).

risks.risk: Chain/cassette/gear wear and lubrication state may be poor (affects reliability).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of chain + cassette/gear teeth and a short ride/roll test showing smooth drivetrain engagement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'drivetrain wear unknown' (worst-case: needs cleaning/lubrication and possible replacement).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of gear shifters/derailleurs (or confirm single-speed) for both bikes.
Video: brake lever squeeze + wheel spin test for front and rear brakes on both bikes.
Close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls for both bikes; confirm tubes/any punctures.
Video: wheel spin to check wobble/out-of-true for both bikes.
Full photos showing all accessories/parts: headlight, reflectors, pedals, and basket attachment security for both bikes.
Close-up photos of chain and cassette/gear teeth plus a short roll/ride test showing smooth shifting/engagement.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies two adult bicycles with similar white frames, baskets, and front suspension, so a worst-case price can be set. However, key safety and condition details (brakes, tires, gears, wheel trueness, missing parts) are not confirmed, so it should be priced at the worst-case until proof is provided.
